description: Stations vélos en libre service Tanlib – flux en temps réel is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by réseau tanlib. Real-time data flow of Free Service Bikes in JSON format, according to GBFS standard. More information on the service at tanlib. Coverage: réseau tanlib. The portal shows the English title as "Tanlib self-service bike stations – real-time feed" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is réseau tanlib. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GBFS. The listing shows 2024-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
